name: Crypt of the Tercio de Montserrat, Montserrat
story: The Tercio de Requetés de Nuestra Señora de Montserrat was a unit of Catalan Carlist volunteers who fought on the Nationalist side, many of them having escaped from Republican Catalonia. It suffered heavy losses at Codo (Aragon) in August 1937 and in the Battle of the Ebro, including at Quatre Camins near Vilalba dels Arcs. Its dead were brought to a crypt at the monastery of Montserrat, Catalonia's national shrine. The crypt is a reminder that Catalan society was divided by the war.
see: A mausoleum or crypt with the names of the unit's dead, within the Montserrat monastery complex.
plan: In the monastery precinct (rack railway or cable car from the Llobregat valley); access to the crypt may be restricted, so ask at the information office.
